title: Forging the Spell
description: A surreal steampunk scene shows a mechanical dragon-like creature with bat wings perched on an anvil, its mouth open as it extrudes long strands of yellow pasta. Various tools including a hammer, chisel, and tongs float around it against cracked yellow walls with floating text and numbers.
